title: Mask Adoption Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior emerges and evolves in a population under social influence, information dynamics, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: social_interaction_at_location
interactions.description: People co-located interact, observe each other's mask use, exchange information, and experience social influence and enforcement effects.

interactions.name: policy_broadcast
interactions.description: Public health authority broadcasts guidance or mandates that influence person compliance and location policies.

interactions.name: misinformation_broadcast
interactions.description: Media outlets disseminate information or misinformation that shifts person attitudes and perceived risk.

interactions.name: enforcement_event
interactions.description: Location staff or authorities apply enforcement (e.g., denial of entry, fines), affecting compliance and future behavior.

interactions.name: risk_feedback_loop
interactions.description: Environment provides a prevalence signal that updates perceived risk and influences mask adoption decisions.

metrics.name: average_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mean fraction of people wearing masks each day; can be tracked over time and averaged over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days until the adoption rate first reaches or exceeds the specified adoption_threshold.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_days
metrics.description: Number of consecutive days the adoption rate remains at or above the adoption_threshold.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of people complying with mask mandates when mandates are active.

metrics.name: adoption_variance
metrics.description: Variance of mask adoption across demographic or network groups, indicating inequality or clustering.

metrics.name: misinformation_impact
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate following misinformation broadcasts (e.g., average drop within a window after events).

metrics.name: cumulative_person_days_masked
metrics.description: Sum over time of the number of people masked each day, capturing total protective behavior.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_bounds
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rates remain within [0,1] for all timesteps and groups.

validation_criteria.name: stability_or_convergence
validation_criteria.description: Adoption trajectory stabilizes (change below a small epsilon) or reaches a steady oscillatory pattern by the end of the time horizon.

validation_criteria.name: sensitivity_sanity
validation_criteria.description: Adoption increases when social_influence_strength, information_campaign_intensity, or enforcement_strength increase, all else equal.

validation_criteria.name: replicability
validation_criteria.description: With a fixed random seed, repeated runs yield identical trajectories for key metrics.
